patch_description: Limit the aggregate two-hop reward for each origin-destination pair to 75% of that pair’s direct-link reward. The current code assigns a reward to every feasible intermediate node, so many individually modest two-hop terms can collectively dominate the direct-service signal. Capping their total magnitude preserves the relative ranking of candidate paths while reducing the chance that the QUBO over-favors networks with many indirect routes. This follows the supplied recommendation and keeps the number of quadratic terms unchanged.
